build_avalidate.py.out/avalidate.json: NAMIBIA RESTORED (deliberate change, 9 Sep): pd.read_csv read its ISO2 "NA" as missing and five readers filtered "NA" explicitly, so every per-country result silently dropped Namibia. Each diff was walked: the only new keys are NA/NAM and every numeric move is Namibia entering a share or ranking. Two are substantive and verified directly in BACI 2024: Namibia is the 3rd cobalt exporter ($119m; $73m to China, its top supplier for 260500+282200), and its arsenic trioxide exports (Tsumeb) cut China's world arsenic share by 20-33 points in several years.
